title: Snow sources beyond GHCN-Daily: SNOTEL (AWDB), SNODAS, NOHRSC snowfall analysis, CoCoRaHS
checked_on: 2026-10-19 (requests from 03:01 to 03:12 UTC; SNODAS 2025 size survey ran separately, about 03:05 to 03:08 UTC)
bottom_line: NOHRSC publishes one season-total snowfall GeoTIFF per water year (2008-09 through 2026-27 to date). Measured files: 2,354,154 bytes for 2025-26 and 2,402,986 bytes for 2024-25, on a 0.04 degree WGS84 grid. At the Billings centre cell the two seasons read 33.85 and 50.29 (units not stated in the file; inferred to be inches). SNODAS solid precipitation (product 1025, IL01) is a daily water equivalent per 1 km cell; summing it by water year would give a per-year value everywhere, but that needs the same daily tar downloads and is model output, not snowfall. SNOTEL has 97 Montana sites (96 active) at 4,250 to 9,200 ft, so it covers mountain points only. SNODAS gives daily 1 km snow depth and SWE, but five years of daily tars come to about 19.6 GB at the 2025 average.
recommendation: 1) Snow by year at every location: NOHRSC season-total GeoTIFF per water year (0.04 degree). Legal basis: NWS public-domain terms with three conditions (no ownership claim, no implied endorsement, no altered content presented as official). Store per-cell season values for the Montana box (34,916 cells; about 0.14 MB raw float32 per season, about 2.46 MB JSON for five seasons, estimate). Five water years is about 12 MB of downloads (two seasons measured, three estimated at the measured size). Caveat: a 4 km analysis, not a point measurement; units and accuracy must be confirmed before display. 2) Daily snow on the ground: SNODAS via NSIDC (G02158), only if the owner needs a daily history. Cite the data set (NSIDC condition). Backfill is about 19.6 GB for five years at the 2025 mean (43.3 GB if the winter sample day is used as the per-day size). The 2021-2026 window is outside the 2014-10-09 to 2019-10-10 zero-error period. Treat int16 32,767 cells as errors (high-elevation Cascades in the sample). 3) Mountain point checks: SNOTEL (AWDB). Use wildcard triplets (*:MT:SNTL). About 76 KB of JSON per station per water year for six elements. USDA terms are not verified (usda.gov and nrcs.usda.gov policy pages returned 403 and 503). 4) CoCoRaHS: do not scrape the ViewData pages (HTML report pages, no export found). CoCoRaHS data are CC BY (attribution). The NOHRSC analysis already assimilates CoCoRaHS observer reports (PDD), so a direct feed adds little for season totals.
method_notes: Requests went through the environment HTTPS proxy with standard certificate checks. No TLS verification was disabled.
One attempt to read the proxy README and proxy status page was denied by the environment permission classifier. It was not retried and no workaround was attempted.
AWDB reset the connection 3 times in about 11 requests; retries succeeded. The v1 elements path returned 404; reference-data?referenceLists=elements worked.
NOHRSC HEAD responses had no Content-Length; sizes come from GET bodies.
SNODAS 2025 sizes come from 365 HEAD requests (scratch file snodas-2025-sizes.tsv). Two sample days were downloaded and read in memory with tarfile; nothing was extracted to disk.

Interpreter used for reading downloads: /home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -I. The venv has numpy, pyshp, pyproj, pygrib, h5py; PIL and tifffile were already present in the same venv. No package was installed.
Downloads folder: /home/user/wt/research-b35/scratch-snow-alternatives/downloads (deleted at the end of the run).

facts.claim: NOHRSC analysis method and inputs (PDD, updated March 2022)
facts.value: Season total resets each 1 October. 24-hour analyses at 00 and 12 UTC; 6-hour at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC; 48-hour, 72-hour and season totals aggregated from daily 12 UTC analyses. Regenerated several times a day for 5 days. Inputs: Cooperative observers, CoCoRaHS observers, NWS spotter reports; Stage IV QPE and HRRR in the background; GHCN-D used for a snowfall-to-liquid-ratio climatology.

ViewData pages are ASP.NET HTML report pages. No export, CSV or Excel control was found on ListDailyPrecipReports (129,868 B), StationSnowSummary (24,228 B) or ListSnowflakeReports (28,355 B). The ViewData landing page (21,108 B) says Water Year Summary Reports are "available for download"; that link was not located.

design_options.option: C. SNODAS daily snow depth and SWE at 1 km (NSIDC G02158)
design_options.what_it_gives: Daily modelled snow depth, SWE, solid precipitation (24 h), snowpack temperature, from 30 September 2003. Product 1025 IL01 (solid precipitation, 24 h, water equivalent) summed by water year is a model water-equivalent per 1 km cell (not a snowfall depth).

design_options.legal_basis: NOAA/NOHRSC data distributed by NSIDC; citation is a stated condition (G02158 landing page).
design_options.caveats: Model output, not observations. 32,767 overflow cells at high elevation. 2014-10-09 to 2019-10-10 zero errors (outside the 2021-2026 window). Not a snow-by-year total.

open_questions: NOHRSC GeoTIFF units are not printed in the file or the PDD text read. Inches are inferred from magnitude and location of maxima. Confirm with NOHRSC (contact in the PDD) or the interactive map legend before any display.
NOHRSC accuracy for points away from observers is not stated in the PDD text read. Treat it as an analysis until an accuracy statement is found.

NOHRSC season-file names with 00 UTC end times returned 404 and 12 UTC end times returned 200 (three tests), consistent with the PDD (season totals aggregate daily 12 UTC analyses). Not tested: intermediate regenerations within the 5-day window.
USDA public-domain statement not retrieved (usda.gov policy pages 403; nrcs.usda.gov 503). Needed before SNOTEL data are published.
SNOTEL update cadence and day boundary not documented on pages read. Observed lag only. dataTimeZone -8.0 is the station-list value; the Montana local-time convention was not verified.
CoCoRaHS license discrepancy (CC BY 3.0 in the data statement; CC BY 4.0 in the footer of the same page) needs owner or CoCoRaHS confirmation.
CoCoRaHS Water Year Summary download link not located (ViewData landing says it is available for download). Format and terms not checked.
GHCN-D US1 overlap for CoCoRaHS not checked here.
Montana box coordinates are approximate and not clipped to the state boundary; Montana box numbers include neighbouring states.
Snow by year at the town level needs a point or cell rule (which NOHRSC cell serves an address). Not tested here.
SNODAS daily cadence beyond one sample per year (2025) and the per-day size for 2021 to 2024 were not measured; the backfill numbers use 2025 as the proxy.
Five-year NOHRSC total (about 12 MB) assumes the three unmeasured seasons are close in size to the two measured.

SNODAS 1025 IL01 summed by water year would give a model water-equivalent per 1 km cell for every location. Not built or tested here; it would need the full daily tar archive (about 19.6 GB for five years).
